details.name: VLSI CIRCUIT DESIGN
details.prerequisites:
PCECT302 Solid State Devices, 
PCECT303 Analog Circuits,   
PBECT304 Logic Circuit Design

topics: Fabrication techniques:  Material Preparation Purification and Crystal growth (CZ process)
Thermal Oxidation- Dry and Wet oxidation
Chemical Vapor Deposition and Physical Vapor Deposition
MOSFET Fabrication techniques : Twin-Tub fabrication sequence
Static CMOS Logic Design : MOSFET Logic Design - NMOS Inverter (Static analysis only)
Static and transient analysis of CMOS inverter
Static and dynamic power dissipation (detailed analysis not required)
Realization of logic functions with static CMOS logic
Layout Design and Design rules:  Stick Diagram and Design rules-micron rules and Lambda rules. (definitions only)
two input NAND and NOR gates.
Pass transistors and Transmission gate logic:  Basic concepts
Realisation of logic gates using pass transistors and complementary pass transistors
Dynamic logic Design:  Pre charge, Logic evaluation
Realisation of logic gates circuits using dynamic logic (NAND and NOR)
Sequential Logic and Memory design:  Behaviour of bistable elements
CMOS D latch and edge triggered flip flop
Read Only Memory- 4x4 MOS ROM Cell Arrays (NOR, NAND)
Random Access Memory- SRAM-Six transistor CMOS SRAM cell
DRAM-Three transistor and One transistor Dynamic Memory Cell.

partA.description:
2 Questions from each module.  
Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 2 marks

partB.description: 2 questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered. Each question can have a maximum of 2 sub divisions. Each question carries 6 marks.

courseOutcomes.description: Explain VLSI design methodologies including ASIC types, SoC and FPGA devices, design flows, methodologies.
Design, analyse and create the layout of static CMOS logic circuits adhering to design rules and specifications.
Design and analysis of dynamic logic circuits and the implementation of basic storage cells.
